# Know who to follow up with today — and which sources actually reply.

> Free job application tracker that stays on your device: no account, nothing uploaded. Log applications, get follow-up reminders (calendar export), see which sources actually reply, and export to CSV any time.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
